main.description: Asks for a new maintainers record for a scope, with the entries behind its commitments. The caller must be an owner of the scope. The registry holds the record, outside the scope's repository, until the previous record's 'ownerThreshold' of owners have attested it, and 'dev.zena-lang.registry.completeChange' writes it; until then the previous record decides every role.

scope.description: The scope, by its DID, on this registry.

entries.description: The entries behind the record's commitments, which the registry keeps private.

swapRecord.description: The CID the record must have now; the write fails with 'InvalidSwap' otherwise.

uri.description: Where the new record will be written, which an attestation names.

cid.description: The new record's CID, which an attestation names.
